Badge.summary: a small status chip with a tone (success, warning, danger, info, neutral)

props.name: text
props.description: the status, in the owner's language — one or two words

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral (default), muted (secondary text), success (green), warning (amber), danger (red) or info (blue)

Button.summary: a button that runs one of the tree's actions (copy, resetState, openUrl, openEntity) or writes a value to state

props.name: label
props.description: what the button does ("Copy result")

props.name: onClick
props.description: {"action": "<action name>"} or {"set": "<state name>"} with value

props.name: value
props.description: what a {"set": …} click writes

props.name: variant
props.description: primary for the one main action (default), secondary beside it

props.name: icon
props.description: a glyph before the label (copy, reset, link, add, check, next, calendar, info)

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: the button takes the whole width

Caption.summary: muted secondary text: a sub-line, a unit, a date, a method note

props.name: text
props.description: the secondary text, in the owner's language

Carousel.summary: slides side by side with previous / next buttons; each child is a slide, or the children repeat per item of `items`

props.name: items
props.description: the list the children repeat over, one slide per item ($item binds a field of the item)

props.name: visibleItems
props.description: how many slides are fully visible at once (1 to 4, default 2); the next one peeks in

props.name: showArrows
props.description: show the previous / next buttons (default true)

props.name: label
props.description: what the slides are, for screen readers (e.g. "Visitors per channel")

slots.name: children
slots.description: the slides (one node each) or, with `items`, the template of one slide

Chart.summary: a line, area, bar, pie, donut, scatter, heatmap, funnel or radar chart over rows; bars with a change per bar; a sparkline in a compact slot

props.name: kind
props.description: line, area, bar, pie, donut, scatter, heatmap, funnel or radar

props.name: data
props.description: the rows (objects), usually a binding: {"$data":…}, {"$computed":…}, {"$from":…}

props.name: x
props.description: the row field of the category / time axis (the slice name of a pie, the row of a heatmap, the stage of a funnel, the axis of a radar)

props.name: series
props.description: the plotted fields: [{"field","label","visible"?}] — one for a pie or a funnel, one column each for a heatmap

props.name: horizontal
props.description: bar only: horizontal bars, for a ranking or a poll

props.name: stacked
props.description: bar and area only: the series stacked

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: how the values are shown on the axis and in the tooltip (default number)

props.name: currency
props.description: the ISO currency code for valueFormat currency (default EUR)

props.name: min
props.description: the lowest value of the value axis (default: from the data)

props.name: max
props.description: the highest value of the value axis (default: from the data)

props.name: xLabel
props.description: the title of the category axis

props.name: yLabel
props.description: the title of the value axis

props.name: title
props.description: a heading above the chart

props.name: caption
props.description: a muted line under the chart (the period, what the values mean)

props.name: source
props.description: where the values come from ({"name","url"}), shown as the source line

props.name: deltaField
props.description: bar only: the row field of the change against an earlier measurement, shown signed at the right of each bar (plus green, minus red)

props.name: deltaUnit
props.description: what the change counts: pp (percentage points, the figure alone) or % (default: the figure alone)

props.name: deltaLabel
props.description: the line under the bars that says what the change compares with ("Right: change in percentage points since January 2026")

Checkbox.summary: one checkbox that writes true or false to a state value

props.name: label
props.description: what the box switches on

props.name: checked
props.description: whether it is ticked, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes true or false

props.name: description
props.description: one muted line under the label

Code.summary: a block of source code with syntax highlighting, a copy button and a line-wrap toggle

props.name: code
props.description: the source code, line breaks as \n

props.name: language
props.description: the language for the highlighting: php, javascript, typescript, json, html, css, scss, sql, bash, python, java, kotlin, swift, go, rust, ruby, csharp, cpp, c, yaml, xml, markdown, diff, dockerfile, graphql, ini, plaintext; another name shows plain text

props.name: title
props.description: a file name or a short label shown in the header instead of the language name

props.name: wrap
props.description: true wraps long lines from the start (the owner can toggle it); default false scrolls them

DatePicker.summary: a date field with a calendar that writes the picked day (YYYY-MM-DD) to a state value

props.name: value
props.description: the picked day as YYYY-MM-DD, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes the day as YYYY-MM-DD

props.name: label
props.description: a short label above the field

props.name: min
props.description: the earliest day that can be picked, YYYY-MM-DD

props.name: max
props.description: the latest day that can be picked, YYYY-MM-DD

Diagram.summary: a diagram drawn from Mermaid source (flowchart, sequence, state, timeline), with an optional heading and caption

props.name: source
props.description:
the Mermaid source, line breaks as 
, e.g. "flowchart TD
  A[Request] --> B{Widget found?}
  B -- Yes --> C[Select widget]"

props.name: title
props.description: a short heading above the diagram

props.name: caption
props.description: one muted line under the heading: what the diagram shows

Divider.summary: a hairline between two parts, horizontal or vertical

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal (default, in a column) or vertical (between the items of a row)

EntityLink.summary: an entity's name (a competitor, a review, a keyword) that opens its detail panel through an openEntity action

props.name: text
props.description: the entity's name as the owner reads it ("Pizzeria Roma")

props.name: action
props.description: the name of this tree's openEntity action whose ref is the entity's reference from a tool result

props.name: variant
props.description: link = the name inline in a sentence or cell (default), title = the name as the bold headline of a Surface, chip = a small pill with a detail glyph

Favicon.summary: the small site icon of a domain, in front of a source or a result

props.name: url
props.description: a page address or a bare domain (wdr.de) whose site icon is shown

props.name: name
props.description: the site name, read aloud and shown on hover

Flow.summary: small items (badges, labels, chips) that flow like words and wrap onto more lines

props.name: gap
props.description: the space between the items: none, xsmall, small (default), medium or large

props.name: align
props.description: where the items of a line sit vertically: start, center (default) or end

slots.name: children
slots.description: the items, each at its own width

Form.summary: a form around inputs: its submit sends the field values to you as the owner's answer (optional decline)

props.name: name
props.description: the form id its submit names: letters, digits, `_` or `-`, at most 64, unique in the tree (e.g. "holidayHours")

props.name: title
props.description: the form heading, in the owner's language

props.name: description
props.description: one line under the heading: what the answer is used for

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: the submit button label, in the owner's language (default "Send")

props.name: declineLabel
props.description: a decline button label (e.g. "Not now"); without it the form has no decline

props.name: fields
props.description: the state names the submit sends, in this order; default: every state name the form's inputs bind

props.name: requiredFields
props.description: state names that must be filled (not empty, a checkbox ticked) before the form submits

slots.name: children
slots.description: the form body: inputs and the text and layout around them

slots.name: header
slots.description: at most two small items at the end of the heading: a badge, a popover that explains the method

Grid.summary: equal columns (1 to 4), one child per cell; drops to fewer columns on a narrow screen

props.name: columns
props.description: the most columns side by side (1 to 4, default 2)

props.name: gap
props.description: the space between the children: none, xsmall, small, medium (default, between rows and tiles) or large (between sections)

props.name: minColumnWidth
props.description: the narrowest a cell may get before the grid shows fewer columns: compact (KPI tiles) or regular (charts, images, text tiles); default compact when every cell is a KpiTile, Pressable, Badge, Icon, Favicon or Button, else regular

slots.name: children
slots.description: the cells, one node each, filled row by row; 1 column = full cells, 2 = regular, 3–4 = compact

Icon.summary: one design-system icon (check, close, warning, star, arrows, …) in a tone

props.name: name
props.description: the icon (check, close, warning, info, star, arrowUp, …)

props.name: tone
props.description: its colour: neutral (default), muted (secondary text), success (green), warning (amber), danger (red) or info (blue)

props.name: size
props.description: default small

props.name: label
props.description: what the icon means, for screen readers and the tooltip

Image.summary: one picture with alt text, an optional title, caption and source chip; opens in a lightbox

props.name: src
props.description: the image URL (https, or a data:image URI)

props.name: alt
props.description: what the image shows, in one short sentence (read aloud by screen readers, shown when the image fails)

props.name: title
props.description: the bold line under the image

props.name: caption
props.description: the muted line under the title

props.name: source
props.description: where the image was found ({"name","url"}), shown as a chip over the image

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: the frame the image is cropped to (default 4:3)

props.name: fit
props.description: cover crops a photo to the frame (default), contain shows a logo whole

ImageGroup.summary: a gallery of pictures as a grid, a carousel or a magazine layout; each opens in a lightbox

props.name: images
props.description: the pictures: [{"src","alt","title"?,"caption"?,"source"?:{"name","url"}}], src and alt required per picture

props.name: layout
props.description: grid (default), carousel or magazine (one hero over tiles)

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: the frame of each tile (default 4:3; the carousel and the magazine hero use 16:9 when unset)

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: grid only: how many tiles show before the last one counts the rest (default 4)

Input.summary: a one-line text or number field that writes what is typed to a state value

props.name: value
props.description: the current text or number, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes what is typed

props.name: label
props.description: a short label above the field

props.name: placeholder
props.description: shown while the field is empty

props.name: inputType
props.description: what is typed (default text)

props.name: maxLength
props.description: the most characters the field takes

KpiTile.summary: one headline number as a tile: label, hero value, unit, change with a good/bad arrow, detail line

props.name: label
props.description: what the number is, above it ("Visitors", "MRR month 12")

props.name: value
props.description: the number (formatted by `format`) or an already written value ("4,32 %")

props.name: format
props.description: how a numeric value is shown (default number)

props.name: currency
props.description: the ISO currency code for format currency (default EUR)

props.name: decimals
props.description: the fraction digits of a numeric value (default: up to 2)

props.name: signed
props.description: a positive value gets a plus sign (a growth rate)

props.name: unit
props.description: a lower-case unit line under the number ("visits", "per month")

props.name: delta
props.description: the change against the comparison period, signed (+5, -0.49)

props.name: deltaFormat
props.description: how the change is shown (default number)

props.name: deltaLabel
props.description: what the change compares with ("vs. September")

props.name: higherIsBetter
props.description: false for a number where less is better (a rank, a churn rate) — the arrow colour follows (default true)

props.name: tone
props.description: the judgement colour of the hero value itself (default neutral)

props.name: detail
props.description: a muted line under the tile ("All channels", "simulated")

props.name: source
props.description: where the number comes from ({"name","url"}), shown as the source line

Label.summary: a short label above a value, an input or a group

props.name: text
props.description: the label, in the owner's language — a few words

Link.summary: a text link that opens an http(s) page in a new tab

props.name: text
props.description: the link text, in the owner's language

props.name: url
props.description: the http(s) address it opens in a new tab

List.summary: a hairline-divided list: items (strings or title/description/meta/value) or ListItem children

props.name: items
props.description: the short form: strings, or {"title","description"?,"meta"?,"value"?}

props.name: marker
props.description: bullet, number, check or none (default none)

props.name: emptyText
props.description: the line shown when the list has no entries

slots.name: children
slots.description: ListItem nodes and Repeats of ListItems

ListItem.summary: one List entry: title, description, meta, value, plus nodes under it and at its end

props.name: title
props.description: the entry, bold

props.name: description
props.description: a line under the title

props.name: meta
props.description: a muted line (a date, a source)

props.name: value
props.description: a figure at the end of the entry

slots.name: children
slots.description: nodes shown under the title

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: at the end of the entry: a badge, an icon, a sparkline

Map.summary: an interactive map: labelled points with rating badges, a carousel of the points, an optional route line, full-screen expand

props.name: points
props.description: the places, each {"label","lat","lng"} with optional "rating" (0–5), "subtitle" (category), "detail" (a status line such as opening state) with "detailTone" (a tone of the kit: success for open, danger for closed, warning for closing soon; also neutral, muted, info), "image" (an http(s) photo URL) and "action" (the name of an openEntity action of this tree)

props.name: title
props.description: what the points are (e.g. "Cafés in Münster"), the heading of the full-screen list

props.name: route
props.description: draw a route line through the points in their order and number the markers

props.name: routePath
props.description: the route line as [{"lat","lng"}, …] when a tool returned the real path; without it the line joins the points directly

props.name: routeLabel
props.description: one short line on the route, e.g. its duration or length, shown on the map

props.name: carousel
props.description: the carousel of the points along the bottom edge: auto (shown, default) or hidden

props.name: minHeight
props.description: the map height in CSS pixels (240–560, default 330)

props.name: pointAction
props.description: the name of the action a point without its own "action" runs — over $from points a row-bound openEntity action ({"type":"openEntity","ref":{"$item":"entityRef"}}) opens each row's entity

Markdown.summary: formatted text: a safe Markdown subset (no HTML, no images), http(s) links in a new tab

props.name: markdown
props.description: the formatted text (Markdown without HTML, images or code fences), in the owner's language

Math.summary: a formula typeset from LaTeX, as a centred block or inline in a sentence, with an optional heading and caption

props.name: latex
props.description: the formula in LaTeX math notation, without $ delimiters, e.g. "CR = \frac{N_{Conversions}}{N_{Visitors}} \times 100\%"

props.name: display
props.description: "block" (default) centres the formula on its own line, "inline" sets it inside a line of text

props.name: title
props.description: a short heading above a block formula ("Conversion rate"), shown with a LaTeX badge

props.name: caption
props.description: one muted line under a block formula: what the symbols mean, or a worked example

Popover.summary: a small button (label + info icon) that opens a floating explanation on click

props.name: label
props.description: the button text (e.g. "Method")

props.name: text
props.description: the explanation as plain text

props.name: icon
props.description: the icon before the label: info (default), help or none

props.name: placement
props.description: which edge of the button the panel lines up with: start or end (default — for a button at the right of a title row)

slots.name: content
slots.description: the explanation, when it is more than one plain text

Pressable.summary: makes its content one clickable area that sets a state value or runs an action

props.name: onClick
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} (writes `value`) or {"action": "<action name>"}

props.name: value
props.description: the value a {"set": …} click writes into the state

props.name: isSelected
props.description: draw the selection ring (bind a computed comparison, e.g. channel == "Organic")

props.name: label
props.description: what the click does, for screen readers (e.g. "Show the organic channel")

slots.name: children
slots.description: what the clickable area shows (no inputs, no other pressable)

Quote.summary: a quotation: the quoted words, who said them and where they were published

props.name: text
props.description: the quoted words, verbatim

props.name: attribution
props.description: who said or wrote it

props.name: source
props.description: where it was published ({"name","url"}), shown as a link after the attribution

slots.name: children
slots.description: the quoted content, when it is more than one plain text

RadioGroup.summary: radio buttons: one of a few explained choices, the picked one written to a state value

props.name: options
props.description: the choices: a list of labels, or of {"id", "label", "description", "disabled"} objects; the picked id (or label) is written to the state

props.name: value
props.description: the picked choice, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes the picked id

props.name: label
props.description: a short label above the group

props.name: direction
props.description: the buttons under each other (default) or side by side

Repeat.summary: its children once per item, $item bound to the item (table rows, list items, tiles)

props.name: items
props.description: the list to repeat over, usually a binding ({"$data":…}, {"$computed":…})

props.name: limit
props.description: show the first N items only

slots.name: children
slots.description: the nodes rendered once per item

Select.summary: a drop-down: one of a longer list of choices, the picked one written to a state value

props.name: options
props.description: the choices: a list of labels, or of {"id", "label", "description", "disabled"} objects; the picked id (or label) is written to the state

props.name: value
props.description: the picked choice, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes the picked id

props.name: label
props.description: a short label above the control

props.name: placeholder
props.description: shown while nothing is picked

Slider.summary: a slider between min and max that writes the number to a state value and shows it formatted

props.name: min
props.description: the smallest value

props.name: max
props.description: the largest value

props.name: step
props.description: the step between two values (default 1)

props.name: value
props.description: the current value, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes the number

props.name: label
props.description: what the number is, shown left of the value

props.name: unit
props.description: written after the shown value ("%", "€", "km")

props.name: decimals
props.description: decimal places of the shown value (default: as many as the step has)

props.name: showValue
props.description: show the formatted value beside the label (default true)

SourceRef.summary: the source line of the shown values: each source with icon and link, licence and author when given

props.name: sources
props.description: the sources, each {"name", "url"?, "title"?, "author"?, "license"?, "licenseUrl"?} — name = the publisher or site

Spacer.summary: empty room: a fixed step, or all the free room of a row (grow)

props.name: size
props.description: the extra space: small, medium (default) or large

props.name: grow
props.description: take all the free room of the row or column, pushing the following nodes to the end

Stack.summary: a row or a column of nodes with one gap step between them; rows wrap on a narrow screen

props.name: direction
props.description: row (side by side) or column (one under the other, the default)

props.name: gap
props.description: the space between the children: none, xsmall, small, medium (default, between rows and tiles) or large (between sections)

props.name: align
props.description: cross-axis alignment: start, center, end, stretch (the column default) or baseline

props.name: justify
props.description: main-axis distribution: start (default), center, end or between (first and last at the edges, e.g. a title left and a control right)

props.name: wrap
props.description: a row continues on the next line when it does not fit (default true)

slots.name: children
slots.description: the nodes of the row or column, in order

Surface.summary: a titled surface grouping nodes, with optional media, header controls, body and footer

props.name: title
props.description: the title of the surface, in the owner's language

props.name: subtitle
props.description: one muted line under the title (what the numbers are, the period)

props.name: density
props.description: regular (default) or compact (smaller padding, for tiles in a grid or carousel)

slots.name: media
slots.description: one image or video flush with the top of the surface

slots.name: header
slots.description: controls and badges at the end of the title row (tabs, a badge, a popover)

slots.name: children
slots.description: the body, one node under the other

slots.name: footer
slots.description: a caption line or small actions at the foot

Svg.summary: a sanitised vector graphic from SVG markup (no scripts, no external references); the markup may follow the state through a computed text

props.name: markup
props.description: one <svg> element with a viewBox, e.g. "<svg viewBox='0 0 200 200'>…</svg>"; bind it to a computed text to make the drawing follow the state

props.name: label
props.description: what the graphic shows, in one sentence (read out by screen readers)

props.name: title
props.description: a short heading above the graphic

props.name: caption
props.description: one muted line under the heading

Table.summary: a table: columns + rows, or TableRow / Repeat children whose TableCells hold other nodes

props.name: columns
props.description: the short form: [{"key","label","align"?,"format"?,"decimals"?,"currency"?,"unit"?}] — the header row and how each cell is shown

props.name: rows
props.description: the short form: the rows (objects with the column keys), usually a binding

props.name: caption
props.description: a muted line under the table (what the figures are, the date)

props.name: emptyText
props.description: the line shown when the short form has no rows

props.name: source
props.description: where the figures come from ({"name","url"}, or a list of them when the values come from several pages), shown as the source line

slots.name: children
slots.description: TableRow nodes and Repeats of TableRows, in display order

TableCell.summary: one table cell: a formatted value, a share bar or heat tint, and compact nodes (icon, badge, sparkline)

props.name: value
props.description: the cell text or number, usually {"$item":"field"}

props.name: format
props.description: how a numeric value is shown (default number)

props.name: currency
props.description: the ISO currency code for format currency (default EUR)

props.name: decimals
props.description: the fraction digits of a numeric value (default: up to 2)

props.name: unit
props.description: a unit written after the value

props.name: align
props.description: start, center or end (numbers: end)

props.name: tone
props.description: the judgement colour of the value (success: a +2 in green, danger: a -3 in red)

props.name: signed
props.description: a positive number gets a plus sign (a change column)

props.name: bar
props.description: a share bar in the cell, the filled part from 0 to 1

props.name: heat
props.description: tints the cell by intensity from 0 to 1 (a heatmap cell); no value = an empty cell

slots.name: children
slots.description: nodes shown in the cell after the value (compact: a chart is a sparkline, an image a thumbnail)

TableRow.summary: one table row of TableCells; header for the column titles, emphasis for a total row

props.name: header
props.description: the column header row

props.name: emphasis
props.description: a total or summary row, shown bold

slots.name: children
slots.description: the TableCell nodes, one per column

Tabs.summary: a segmented control: a few short choices side by side, the picked one written to a state value

props.name: options
props.description: the choices: a list of labels, or of {"id", "label", "description", "disabled"} objects; the picked id (or label) is written to the state

props.name: value
props.description: the picked choice, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes the picked id

props.name: label
props.description: a short label above the control

Text.summary: plain text, a paragraph or an inline run; its children are inline nodes on the same line

props.name: text
props.description: the text, in the owner's language (a Text with only children may leave it out)

props.name: weight
props.description: regular (default), medium or bold

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral (default), muted (secondary text), success (green), warning (amber), danger (red) or info (blue)

props.name: maxLines
props.description: clamp the text at this many lines (1–10); the full text shows on hover

slots.name: children
slots.description: inline nodes that follow the text on the same line

Textarea.summary: a multi-line text field that writes what is typed to a state value

props.name: value
props.description: the current text, usually {"$state": "<name>"}

props.name: onChange
props.description: {"set": "<state name>"} — writes what is typed

props.name: label
props.description: a short label above the field

props.name: placeholder
props.description: shown while the field is empty

props.name: rows
props.description: the visible lines (default 3)

props.name: maxLength
props.description: the most characters the field takes, shown as a counter

Title.summary: a heading: the title of the view or of one section of it

props.name: text
props.description: the heading, in the owner's language

props.name: level
props.description: widget = the title of the whole view (default), section = the title of one part of it

Video.summary: one video: title, thumbnail, length, and a videoId or url that plays it

props.name: title
props.description: the video title, as the source names it

props.name: videoId
props.description: the id the video connector returned (plays embedded)

props.name: url
props.description: an http(s) link that opens the video, when there is no videoId

props.name: thumbnail
props.description: the thumbnail image URL

props.name: durationSeconds
props.description: the length in seconds

props.name: channel
props.description: who published it

props.name: source
props.description: where the video was found ({"name","url"}), shown as the source line

Widget.summary: an existing domain widget embedded in the tree (only widgets declared embeddable)

props.name: widget
props.description: the wire name of an embeddable domain widget

props.name: fields
props.description: the widget's own payload fields, as its fence would carry them next to `type`
